test_cases.name: club_attendance_feature
test_cases.input: Help me define requirements for an attendance tracking feature in our Flutter app for Islamic clubs. Admins mark present/absent, parents can view history. We need a design system component for the list.
assertions: Produces structured FR with acceptance criteria
Includes measurable FNR (performance, RTL, offline or accessibility)
Lists explicit out of scope items

test_cases.name: ecommerce_product_detail
test_cases.input: We're building a product detail screen for the e-commerce Flutter app. Need FR, non-functional requirements and what is out of scope before we design the components.
assertions: Defines FNR covering performance and accessibility
Maps implications to design system components or tokens

test_cases.name: vague_request_refinement
test_cases.input: Make requirements for a member management screen. It should be fast and support Arabic.
assertions: Asks clarifying questions or produces strengthened requirements
Turns vague statements into measurable FNR
